name: credential-expires-static
about: The it-21 review case. The token ages out mid-call and the question is a static fact, so the answer comes from the context with no wait. The carried turn still sends its /call-fact check in the background, and that check is refused. The next turn must end the call on the refusal, the way a live lookup would have ended it one turn sooner. This bounds the delay to one turn.

must_say_contains: this is an automated call from CreatoRain
